description: This file defines the React component 'AssetDetailsPage' which manages the user interface for viewing details of an asset, including loading asset data, switching between different tabs (details, site assets, input EF mapping, throughput setup), and related data fetching functions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches asset data from backend using getAsset and updates state.

methods.name: loadMappings
methods.description: Loads input EF mappings from backend via listInputEfSourceMappings and updates state.
